name: Durasphere pivotal trial
question: Does transurethral Durasphere provide comparable stress-incontinence improvement to bovine collagen in women with intrinsic sphincter deficiency?

design.blinding: Patients and research staff conducting evaluations blinded; injectors unblinded
design.population: Women with stress urinary incontinence due to intrinsic sphincter deficiency and abdominal leak-point pressure below 90 cm H2O.
design.description: Multicenter, patient- and evaluator-blinded randomized equivalence trial
design.locator: Full text, Materials and Methods, p 13

verdictNote: The reported equivalence lacks a printed equivalence interval or prespecified decision threshold.
takeaway: Among women with stress incontinence from intrinsic sphincter deficiency, Durasphere and bovine collagen produced similar 12-month continence-grade and pad-weight outcomes in completers; no equivalence margin was reported. Durasphere used less material; urgency and acute retention were more frequent, and acute retention resolved within seven days.

reports.label: Initial randomized report
reports.dateLocator: PubMed citation: July 2001; day approximated as first of month
reports.citation: Lightner D, Calvosa C, Andersen R, et al. "A new injectable bulking agent for treatment of stress urinary incontinence: results of a multicenter, randomized, controlled, double-blind study of Durasphere." *Urology.* 2001;58(1):12-15. doi:10.1016/s0090-4295(01)01148-7
reports.followUp: Efficacy among 235 12-month completers (mean 14 months, range 9–30); safety in all 355 women (mean 11 months, range 1–26); treatment-anchored subset at one year after last treatment

results.measure: At least one-grade improvement at 12 months after initial injection
results.note: Completer analysis; authors reported equivalence, but the article gives a P value for difference and no equivalence interval or prespecified decision threshold.
results.locator: Full text, Results, p 13; Figure 1, p 14

results.measure: Mean reduction in standardized pad weight from baseline to 12 months after initial injection
results.note: Completer analysis; authors reported equivalence, but the article gives a P value for difference and no equivalence interval or prespecified decision threshold.
results.locator: Full text, Results, p 13; Figure 2, p 14; FDA SSED p 13, Table 4 for arm denominators

results.measure: Adverse events in all randomized women during mean 11-month follow-up
results.note: The paper designates safety a third primary endpoint but gives no prespecified safety threshold.
results.locator: Full text, Materials and Methods and Results, p 13; Results, p 14

results.measure: At least one-grade improvement one year after last treatment
results.note: Treatment-anchored subset one year after last treatment; distinct from the initial-injection primary endpoint.
results.locator: Full text, Results, p 13; Figure 1, p 14

harms.label: Urinary urgency lasting more than 24 hours, any attribution
harms.locator: Full text, Results, pp 13–14; FDA SSED p 15, Table 6 for event counts
harms.note: More frequent with Durasphere; the paper reports P=0.001 for the adverse-event comparison. Urgency resolved by study end in 90% of Durasphere versus 65% of collagen recipients (P=0.021).

harms.label: Acute retention lasting more than 24 hours and at most seven days, any attribution
harms.locator: Full text, Results, pp 13–14; FDA SSED p 15, Table 6 for event counts
harms.note: More frequent with Durasphere; the paper reports P=0.001 for the adverse-event comparison. Retention was treated with intermittent self-catheterization and resolved in all affected women by day 7.

delivery.label: Initial injected volume
delivery.note: P<0.001 for the between-agent volume difference.

delivery.label: Injection technique
delivery.value: Both agents were injected transurethrally under direct vision at the bladder neck. Durasphere used prepackaged 1.0-mL syringes and an 18-gauge needle. The journal report says up to five retreatments at intervals of at least seven days; the FDA protocol summary limits retreatments to four.
delivery.locator: Full text, Materials and Methods, p 13

delivery.label: Total injected volume including repeat injections
delivery.note: P<0.001 for the between-agent total-volume difference.
